facts.fact: AI Hub Senegal, with the digital ministry and the French embassy, has published in open access the Kiriku suite, including a Wolof speech-recognition model with a stated 20.7% word error rate, per the NET&PRO article.
The Kallaama speech dataset with 125 transcribed hours across three Senegalese languages is cited as an existing dataset, per the NET&PRO article.
